        self.dim = dim
        self.seed = seed
        self.rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)

        lb = func.bounds.lb
        ub = func.bounds.ub
        budget = self.budget
        rng = self.rng

        # population size
        pop_size = min(10 * dim, budget // 2)
        if pop_size < 2:
            pop_size = 2

        # initialize population
        pop = lb + (ub - lb) * rng.rand(pop_size, dim)
        fitness = np.full(pop_size, np.inf)
        best_x = None
        best_val = np.inf

                break

            calls += 1
